settings.subtitle: Company, tax, language, and backups
settings.taxEnabledHint: When disabled, tax is hidden on invoices and amounts are calculated without tax.
settings.defaultLocaleHint: Used on first visit if the user has not chosen a language in the navbar.
settings.adminRoleLocked: Admin role permissions are fixed and cannot be changed
settings.autoBackupNote: Two daily backups at the times below (requires cron: php artisan schedule:run every minute).
settings.backupRetentionPolicy: Local backups older than 7 days are deleted after each successful backup, only if a fresh valid backup (<24h) exists, always keeping the newest 3. Drive/Telegram copies are untouched.
settings.backupNoFreshWarning: No fresh backup (<24h) — automatic deletion is blocked until backups resume.
settings.backupDestHint: Connect Google Drive and Telegram here. Secrets are encrypted on the server and never returned after save. Environment variables remain a fallback.
settings.driveNotConnected: Warning: Google Drive is not connected — backups stay local only. Connect Drive to avoid data loss.
settings.driveCredentialsHint: Upload the Google Cloud service-account JSON and share the Drive folder with its client_email.
settings.secretKeepHint: Saved — leave blank to keep current value
settings.telegramChatHint: Message the bot, then read chat_id from getUpdates (or use a group/channel id).
settings.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect will remove UI-saved settings. Continue?
settings.dbBackupHint: PostgreSQL — admins only. Restore replaces current data.
settings.exportFullExcelHint: Multi-sheet Excel archive of project data (no passwords or secrets). Also generated automatically with every backup.
settings.backupListError: Could not load list — ensure your account has admin access.
settings.noBackupsHint: Create the first backup with the button above.
settings.restoreSqlOnly: Restore is available for SQL/Dump files only.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restoring this backup will replace the current database. Are you sure?
settings.restoreFromFileConfirm: CRITICAL WARNING: Restoring from this file will erase all current database data and replace it with the file contents. This cannot be undone. Continue?
settings.backupRestored: Restore complete — reload the page if needed
settings.rateMeaning: Meaning: 1 of source currency = rate × target currency

settings.barcodeIntro: Most USB scanners act as a keyboard (HID keyboard wedge) — no driver needed. The app captures digits then Enter.
settings.barcodeStep1: Plug the USB barcode scanner into your PC or tablet.
settings.barcodeStep2: Open Sales, Warehouse, or Barcodes and click the scan field.
settings.barcodeStep3: Scan the label — the product is added or selected automatically.
settings.barcodeStep4: Ensure each product has a barcode saved on its card.
settings.barcodeAdvancedHint: Web Serial API or WebHID may be added later for non-wedge devices — keyboard wedge is the primary method.
settings.whatsappDisconnected: ○ Not connected — uses wa.me + file download
settings.whatsappHow1: Next to Print, choose WhatsApp, then PDF or image, and edit the mobile number if needed.
settings.whatsappHow2: Without Cloud API: the file downloads and WhatsApp opens — attach the file manually from Downloads.
settings.whatsappHow3: With Cloud API: the file is uploaded and sent automatically when credentials are set on the server.
settings.whatsappEnvHint: On the server in .env.prod: WHATSAPP_TOKEN and WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID from Meta Business (WhatsApp Cloud API).
